description: This file contains the implementation of a class browser module for the SmartClient framework, including class definitions, UI component setup, and data source configuration.

classes.name: JavaClassPane
classes.description: A layout component that displays Java source code in a view, with methods to load and highlight source code.

classes.name: JVMClassTree
classes.description: A TreeGrid component representing the Java class hierarchy, backed by JVMClassTreeDS data source.

classes.name: ClassBrowser
classes.description: Main class that manages the class browser UI, including class tree, class panes, and navigation.

methods.name: initWidget
methods.description: Initializes the ClassBrowser widget, setting up class tree, layout, and event handlers.

methods.name: classChanged
methods.description: Handles the event when a class is selected in the class tree, displaying its details.

methods.name: showClassPane
methods.description: Displays a pane with details for a specific class.

methods.name: escapeForId
methods.description: Sanitizes class path strings to be valid HTML element IDs.

methods.name: showPane
methods.description: Creates and displays a new tab pane for class details.
